subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Block Diagrams: System Architecture
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Block Diagrams: System Architecture.

hook.text: A block diagram maps a control system visually — blocks for functions, arrows for signal flow.

buildup.text: Each block has a transfer function. Summing junctions add or subtract signals. Simple and clear.

discovery.text: Series blocks multiply. Parallel blocks add. Feedback loops use the formula G/(1+GH).

twist.text: Complex systems with multiple loops are reduced step by step using block algebra rules.

climax.text: Every control textbook and industrial spec sheet uses block diagrams as the universal language.

punchline.text: Blocks and arrows — the universal blueprint of control systems.

quiz.question: What is the closed-loop transfer function for a system with forward path G and feedback H?
